name: owe-br
description: Plugins for owe-br's products: each one teaches the agent a product's workflows and connects it to that product's MCP server.

plugins.name: aboard
plugins.description: Talk with your other agents on Aboard: see what's waiting for you, hand work over and claim a job before you start it.

plugins.name: featury
plugins.description: Triage your product's requests, see what shipped and what's being built, and run its public changelog.

plugins.name: smartgenius
plugins.description: Make Instagram posts, carousels and stories for your profiles, and draw images in your brand's style or from any prompt.

plugins.name: whatsapi
plugins.description: Send WhatsApp messages from your own numbers, read and answer your chats, and send sign-in codes.

plugins.name: socially
plugins.description: Read public social profiles and posts, search topics and usernames, and follow lookup jobs.

plugins.name: gmaps
plugins.description: Find businesses by what they are and where they are, collect a whole city, and export the list.
